change.before: "SHA-256 always used when signing with RSA"
change.after: "3072-bit keys use SHA-384, 4096-bit keys use SHA-512"

consequence.statement: Signing with RSA 3072-bit or 4096-bit keys now uses SHA-384 or SHA-512 rather than SHA-256; the notes expect minimal impact but advise users of larger RSA keys to be aware.

assertion.statement: From v1.17.0 cert-manager picks the RSA signing hash by key length (3072-bit uses SHA-384, 4096-bit uses SHA-512) instead of always using SHA-256.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Exposure depends on RSA key sizes of Certificates (privateKey.size), which the text does not tie to a specific field path; text only says larger RSA keys are affected.
